purpose: Static concept previews for a keyboard cleaning screen. GIF animation has not been created.

concepts.title: 1. 키보드 스파
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single still concept illustration for the cleaning/keyboard-lock screen of a friendly desktop app, to help choose a later looping GIF.
Art direction shared with a four-image concept family: high-quality charming miniature 3D illustration, soft matte clay and ceramic materials, rounded mechanical keycaps, warm ivory background, creamy whites with muted sage green and soft apricot accents, subtle soft shadows, warm diffuse studio lighting. Sophisticated and cute, clean uncluttered composition, comfortably readable at small size.
Framing: landscape 3:2, gentle three-quarter overhead view, one centered scene with generous breathing room around its edges; full subject visible.
Constraints: produce exactly one illustration, not a grid or storyboard, no UI, no captions, no titles, no watermarks or brand logos. Only the explicitly requested key label may contain text. Static concept art, not an animated file.
Primary request: Keyboard spa. A small ivory keyboard has become an adorable miniature bubble bath. The hero is a large anthropomorphic ESC keycap relaxing among its neighboring rounded keycaps, wrapped in a tiny folded white spa head towel. The keycap has tiny closed curved eyes and a peaceful smile on its front face; the top key label reads exactly "ESC". Pearly white foam nestles between the keycaps and a few translucent soap bubbles float above. One small bubble touches the hero's cheek, hinting at the future animation. Neighboring keys are blank. A few sage keycaps and a small apricot accent make the image warm and soothing. The scene must unmistakably read as a keyboard taking a cozy spa break. Keep foam sculptural and charming, avoid realistic liquid or a flooded real desk.

Primary request: A tiny keyboard cleaner. A very small friendly rounded sage-green cleaning character with a simple face and little arms and legs stands in a wide alley between towering ivory mechanical keycaps. It holds a soft apricot-bristled cleaning brush slightly larger than itself and is earnestly sweeping one fluffy gray dust ball into a neat little pile. The brush visibly touches the dusty keyboard channel. Show a compact recognizable keyboard section on a low rounded base, with a few rows of large blank keycaps providing scale. The hero should be small relative to the keycaps but clearly readable; a slight determined lean makes the effort funny and endearing. It is an unhurried scene with a clear silhouette and few props. All keys blank, no text.

Primary request: Dust bunnies moving out of a keyboard. Three tiny soft fluffy gray dust-bunny characters with little dot eyes and tiny feet are escaping from between the ivory keycaps toward the near edge of a small keyboard. One determined dust bunny carries a tiny apricot suitcase, a second carries a little sage travel bag, and a smaller latecomer is peeking from a keycap gap and hurrying to catch up. Primary request: A calm minimalist keycap wave. A compact elegant ivory keyboard with a clearly aligned matrix of rounded blank mechanical keycaps on a low rounded base. Preserve the coherent keyboard rows and attachment alignment while making the height differences visually clear using shadows.
